title: Nostalgic Velvet Chicken Pilaf
description: A velvety Russian dish featuring chicken and mushimono-steamed vegetables with umami flavors that evokes a sense of nostalgia.
instructions: Dice chicken and onions into small pieces, mince garlic, slice mushrooms and celery.
Steam mushimono-style with 500ml mushroom broth in a lazy-susan-spinner at 180C for about 15 minutes.
In a pan on medium heat, melt butter until foamy. Add minced garlic, stir for 30 seconds.
Add chicken and onion pieces to the pan, cook for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Stir in sliced mushrooms and green peas with salt and pepper. Cook for another minute or two.
Pour into a lazy-susan-spinner serving bowl and drizzle with soy sauce before serving hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
